_comment: Product identifiers and the rules that go with them. PRICES ARE NEVER STORED HERE or anywhere else in this repository - they are read from the App Store at runtime, localised, which is the only place that stays correct when a price changes. These identifiers must match the ones configured in App Store Connect, and an identifier cannot be changed once it has been created there.
_trial: A FREE NON-CONSUMABLE, not an introductory offer. Buying it is how the trial's start date gets signed and stored by Apple, so it survives a reinstall, a new device and a wound-back clock. The trial opens everything in single player; it does not include flying online.
_unlock: One-time non-consumable. Opens every airplane and every lesson, permanently, and includes the first 30 days of online flying. Family Sharing must be OFF for this product in App Store Connect; the app also ignores a family-shared copy of it.
_multiplayer: Auto-renewing, both in ONE subscription group so monthly and yearly are the same thing at two durations and the store handles switching between them. Needed by everyone who flies online, including members entitled to the content through an external provider. Family Sharing OFF. UNLIMITED: the hour cap and the hours top-up were dropped (owner 2026-10-16), so the pass has no allowance attached and there is no hours product. The app still counts each pilot's connected hours on the device, for the cost check only - nothing about them is sent or stored anywhere else.
_gate: Whether the app actually REFUSES a join without the pass. FALSE until the products exist in App Store Connect and the relay checks a join token - with it true today nobody could fly online at all, because there is no product to buy and so no pass to hold. Everything else is live either way: the hours are counted, the paywall sells what the store offers, and CanJoinMultiplayer answers honestly. Flip this to true in the same change that makes the relay require a token, or the two halves disagree.
_links: Shown on the paywall, which App Review requires. Fill these in when the pages are published; the buttons are hidden while they are empty.
